paite: Ka tapa, ka pilna limsak in; ka theihsiamna na bildoh in.
heading: Angkawmna Dem A Vauhilhna
english: My son, pay attention to my wisdom. Turn your ear to my understanding,

paite: Ngentelna na vom theih a, na mukte'n theihna akeptheihna ding un.
english: that you may maintain discretion, that your lips may preserve knowledge.

paite: Numei gina lou mukte'n lah khuaizu atakkhesak ngal a, akam sathau sang in analzaw hi.
english: For the lips of an adulteress drip honey. Her mouth is smoother than oil,

paite: Himahleh atawpna nanung gamsai bang in akha a, namsau hiamtuah bang in ahiam hi.
english: but in the end she is as bitter as wormwood, and as sharp as a two-edged sword.

paite: Akhete sihna lam ah apaisuk a; akalsuante'n Sheol zuan in alen tinten hi.
english: Her feet go down to death. Her steps lead straight to Sheol.

paite: Huchi in hinna lampi phei amu kei hi; alampite akip kei a, ama'n athei kei hi.
english: She gives no thought to the way of life. Her ways are crooked, and she doesn’t know it.

paite: Huaiziak in tu in, ka tapate, hon ngaikhia unla, ka kam a thute a kipan paimang kei un.
english: Now therefore, my sons, listen to me. Don’t depart from the words of my mouth.

paite: Amah a kipan in na lampi gamlapi ah suanmang in, a-inn kongkhak nai ah hong pai ke'n.
english: Remove your way far from her. Don’t come near the door of her house,

paite: Huchi lou in zaw midangte kiang ah na zahtakhuaina na pe kha ding a, na kumte gilou kiang ah.
english: lest you give your honor to others, and your years to the cruel one;

paite: Huchi lou in zaw na hatna in mikhualte avah kha ding ua, gamdangmi inn ah na sepgimnate a-om kha ding;
english: lest strangers feast on your wealth, and your labors enrich another man’s house.

paite: Huan na sa leh na pumpi hihgawp a a-om lai in na tawpna nanung ah na sun kha ding.
english: You will groan at your latter end, when your flesh and your body are consumed,

paite: Huchi in hilhna za nuam lou hi na tel ing e, ka lungtang in salhna na musit na tel e, na chi kha ding.
english: and say, “How I have hated instruction, and my heart despised reproof.

paite: Hon sinsak mite aw ka mang kei a, kei hon hilhte lam leng ka bil in ka na doh kei.
english: I haven’t obeyed the voice of my teachers, nor turned my ear to those who instructed me!

paite: Omkhawmte leh kikhawmpite lak ah gilou tengteng ah siatna ka na hita mahmah hi.
english: I have come to the brink of utter ruin, among the gathered assembly.”

paite: Nangmah tuibem a kipan tuite dawn in, nangmah tuileh a kipan tui luang laite.
english: Drink water out of your own cistern, running water out of your own well.

paite: Na tui nak neite suk thanghuaigawp a om ding hia, kongzingte ah na luite?
english: Should your springs overflow in the streets, streams of water in the public squares?

paite: Nangmah a ding kia hi uhen, nang kiang a mikhualte ding hilou in.
english: Let them be for yourself alone, not for strangers with you.

paite: Na tuikhuk vualzawl in om hen; huan na tuailai zi ah kipak in.
english: Let your spring be blessed. Rejoice in the wife of your youth.

paite: Deihhuai sazukpi leh heksiam sakhipi bang. A-itna leh ngaihnatna in chik lai peuh in leng nang hon lungkimsak gige hen; huan a-itna a vak in om gige in.
english: A loving doe and a graceful deer— let her breasts satisfy you at all times. Be captivated always with her love.

paite: Bangziak in ahia, ka tapa, numei lamdang vak a om a, mikhual ang va kawi ding na hia?
english: For why should you, my son, be captivated with an adulteress? Why embrace the bosom of another?

paite: Mihing lampite lah TOUPA mit ma ah a-om ngal a, ama'n alampite tengteng apheisak hi.
english: For the ways of man are before Yahweh’s eyes. He examines all his paths.

paite: Giloute amah thulimlouhnate'n aman ding a, akhelhna guite a kan in a-om ding hi.
english: The evil deeds of the wicked ensnare him. The cords of his sin hold him firmly.

paite: Hilhna taksap ziak in asi ding a; ahaina thupina ah apaimang ding hi.
english: He will die for lack of instruction. In the greatness of his folly, he will go astray.
